name: @fundet/browser-runtime
description: Neutral browser automation runtime (vendored from Cindy browser-control-runtime; core from openclaw/openclaw, see upstream/browser-runtime.lock.json). Compiled to dist/ and consumed as an EXTERNAL runtime dependency - vite/rollup must NOT bundle the vendored sources.
author: LongMa authors (derived from Cindy by XD Inc.)
_comment: npm deps are devDependencies on purpose: this package ships as a compiled external inside the desktop app, whose package.json declares the same runtime deps (asar hoisted resolution).
